title: Clay Relationship Strength Score Leaderboard
dataSources: Monica contacts (`monica:contact`), Clay relationships (`clay:relationship`), LinkedIn connections (`linkedin:connection`), follow-up reminders (`followup:reminder`), and intro requests (`intro:request`).
app: Monica contact relationship logs, Clay network exports, LinkedIn connection events, follow-up reminder tasks, and warm-intro request trackers streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=clay:relationship strength_score=*
| stats sum(strength_score) as total_value, avg(strength_score) as avg_value by network_segment
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks network segment values by total and average strength score across Clay relationship events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `strength_score` values for each Clay relationship event and review total and average strength score by network segment.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total strength score.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which network segment shows the biggest strength score numbers in your Clay relationship data.
